# Nivin Xavier: Full Profile

> Entrepreneur and marketer since the 8th grade. Data-driven digital marketing, analytics, and brand-building consultant with fifteen years of experience across startups to the Fortune 500. Founder of OmniVue AI, Atlantic Blinds, LifeSpace Blinds, and the Canada Global Export Council. Permanent Resident of Canada, based in Halifax, Nova Scotia.

## Positioning

Creativity, backed by data. Growth you can count.

Nivin describes himself as a failures and a success seasoned individual. He pairs conversion copywriting and brand strategy with a rigorous analytics and measurement stack. He helps clients meaningfully engage with potential customers in the moments that matter, make data-backed decisions, and deliver ROI.

## Story and background

Nivin started a window blinds manufacturing business out of his aunt's garage while still in school, serving both B2B and B2C clients. By age eighteen he was importing blind components directly from suppliers in China and Taiwan to improve margins, becoming one of the early users of Alibaba for import and export. He built and exited two brands, LifeSpace Blinds and AeroFab.

When the 2008 to 2009 recession caused losses in the blinds business, he pivoted into copywriting and has worked in digital, marketing, and analytics ever since. He moved to Halifax because he believes in the Canadian startup ecosystem and wanted to contribute to one of the fastest growing cities in North America.

## Headline results

- 6662% organic e-commerce revenue growth for the e-commerce division of a billion-dollar global car manufacturer
- 521% organic traffic growth on the same engagement
- 331% paid revenue growth
- Over 10 million words written over twelve years, spanning technology, health, marketing, and analytics
- Scaled a digital agency team from 2 people to more than 90
- Built and exited two brands
- Took one startup from idea to acquisition
- Teams he has built have outperformed peer teams by 2.5 times

## Core competencies

Entrepreneurship, Leadership, Problem-Solving, Risk Mitigation, Consulting, Digital Marketing, Digital Transformation, Analytics, Operations, Project Management, Product Management, Human Resources and People Management, Talent Scouting, Strategic Alliances and Partnerships, Profit and Loss, Account Management, Business Development, Content Marketing, Copywriting, Content Writing.

Technical and channel skills: Google Analytics, Web Analytics, Google Tag Manager including server-side tagging, CRM, HubSpot, Jira, Monday.com, SEO, SEM (Google Ads, Bing Ads, LinkedIn Ads), Paid Social (Facebook, Instagram), Email Marketing, Inbound Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization, Branding, Reputation Management, Influencer Marketing, Video Marketing, Shopify, WordPress, Scrum, Agile.

## Services

1. Growth and Digital Strategy: end-to-end digital marketing built around the client P&L. SEO, SEM, paid social, email, and CRO as one connected system.
2. Analytics and Transformation: trustworthy measurement using Google Analytics, server-side Google Tag Manager, attribution, and a cookie-less roadmap.
3. Brand and Conversion Copywriting: websites, landing pages, ads, and content marketing that read human and convert well.
4. Product and Project Leadership: idea to R&D to go-to-market to launch, with Scrum and Agile discipline.
5. Team Building and Talent: scouting and leading technical teams including top Stack Overflow talent.
6. Founder Advisory: strategy, positioning, partnerships, and operational decision support.

## Ventures (2023 to present)

- OmniVue AI (omnivueai.com): a brand intelligence SaaS platform that tracks, benchmarks, and amplifies omni-channel brand exposure across social media, connected TV, linear TV, OTT, and news, around the clock.
- Atlantic Blinds (atlanticblinds.ca): a vertically integrated window covering manufacturer based in Halifax.
- LifeSpace Blinds: a luxury window covering e-commerce brand.
- Canada Global Export Council (cgec.ca): a Canadian not-for-profit founded by Nivin as the exclusive Canadian partner of EICBI, a European Parliament accredited geopolitical forum.

## Career history

- 2023 to present: Founder of OmniVue AI, Atlantic Blinds, LifeSpace Blinds, and the Canada Global Export Council.
- 2017 to 2023: Director of Digital Marketing at Ayruz Data Marketing, a data-driven agency for startups to Fortune 500s. Scaled the team from 2 to over 90 across Halifax, Philadelphia, Cochin, and Trivandrum.
- 2017 to 2021: Product Manager at data POWA, a real-time sports sponsorship valuation software company. Led the product from early idea through R&D to a multi-award winning launch and acquisition by IXUP (Dataworks Group Limited, ASX: DWG).
- 2016 to 2017: Head of Digital Marketing at the Muthoot Group (MLHS), a 130 year old conglomerate. Part of the Managing Director's core team.
- 2013 to 2016: Manager of Digital Marketing and Head of Human Resources at Ayruz Data Marketing.
- 2012 to 2013: Lead, Digital Marketing and SEO at CCubed.
- 1999 to 2022: Entrepreneur in window blinds manufacturing, LifeSpace Blinds and AeroFab.
